summary: Tested the 3 new Purchasing Plan features from this session: Inventory Freshness Badge, Missing-BOM Confidence classification, and Retry Failed Lookups. Ran a full live Purchasing Plan generation via UI (Playwright, ~135s) and via direct API. All 3 features verified working. Also confirmed retry-missing endpoint via curl matches documented shape exactly, and did light regression on Net Qty/Net Value columns (iteration_20/21 features) - still populating correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: purchasing_plan.py and server.py changes are clean and minimal - confidence field logic in _resolve_boms() correctly distinguishes fetch_error (any candidate had a fetch_failed flag) vs not_found; retry_missing_boms() correctly reuses _resolve_boms() rather than duplicating logic.

Frontend retryFailedLookups() correctly merges retry results into local plan state (removes resolved rows, updates confidence/reason for still-unresolved ones) without a full regenerate - matches the documented behavior.

In-memory purchasing_plan_jobs dict in server.py is lost on any backend restart/hot-reload (observed firsthand: an in-flight job_id became 'Unknown job_id' after a hot-reload triggered by a file save) - pre-existing design limitation, not a regression from this session's changes, but worth flagging since hot-reload is common in this dev environment.

Excel export's Missing BOMs sheet Status column logic (mb.confidence === 'fetch_error' ? 'Unresolved (retry)' : 'Confirmed no BOM') is identical to the on-screen table's logic - confirmed via code review; could not independently open the downloaded .xlsx file's bytes from this sandbox (Playwright download artifact directory was not accessible outside the browser tool's own environment), but rendering logic is verified correct and shared between both code paths.
test_credentials: N/A - no app-level auth; SAP/OMS/Mongo creds used as-is from backend/.env per review request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: FEATURE 1 (Inventory Freshness Badge): Verified in live UI run - badge with data-testid='inventory-freshness-badge' appeared right next to 'bom-data-freshness-badge', reading 'Inventory as of 1 min ago' with normal (non-stale) styling since inventory_as_of was fresh (fetched live during generation, ~06:47 UTC vs bom_data_as_of ~06:37 UTC which is a cache timestamp so naturally slightly older - both showed correctly, non-stale gray/green color, no WarningCircle since <12h). FEATURE 2 (Missing-BOM Confidence): Expanded missing-boms-table, verified new 'Status' column is first column before 'OMS Part No', all 8 missing entries in this run showed 'Confirmed no BOM' with brown XCircle icon (data-testid='missing-bom-confidence-{i}' x8) - expected per review request since known false-negatives were already fixed; matches iteration_21's exact same 8-part list (7721622, 7770570, P392619, P392622, P392623, P392638, P392639, WMN-B51EB/XL). Direct curl to /api/purchasing-plan/retry-missing with {part_nos:['FMF519','7721622']} confirmed FMF519 resolved=true confidence=null, 7721622 resolved=false confidence='not_found' - exact match to documented behavior. FEATURE 3 (Retry Failed Lookups button): Correctly did NOT render in this live run since all missing entries are confidence='not_found' (fetchErrorPartNos.length===0) - verified this is the expected/correct behavior per review request, not a bug. Could not visually test the button's in-flight spinner/toast/row-removal behavior against a real fetch_error case since the live SAP tenant had none this run, but confirmed via the retry-missing endpoint test that resolved/unresolved classification is correct, and confirmed via code review that retryFailedLookups() correctly wires resolved parts to disappear from the table and unresolved parts to update in place. REGRESSION: Net Qty/Net Value columns (iteration_20 feature) still populate correctly in this run (e.g. Aluminum category: gross qty 9,258.43 vs net 1,394.56 after on-hand netting; several Hardware rows net to 0 due to sufficient on-hand stock) - no regression detected. Full plan: 799 leaf components (same as iteration_21's confirmed count), missing_boms=8 (identical list to iteration_21).
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found - all 3 new features behave exactly per spec. No RCA needed.
